subject: English
passage: Mount Everest has the highest elevation ______ all the mountains in the world—29,032 feet above sea level.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use between a preposition and its complement. No punctuation is needed between the preposition "of" and its complement "all the mountains in the world." The complement completes the meaning of the preposition in the phrase "the highest elevation of all the mountains in the world," and using punctuation to separate the complement from the preposition results in an ungrammatical sentence.
